summary: Cooperative Fabric 1.20.1 adventure for 1-3 players: the district, the other side of the district and a very grey tower.

mods.purpose: Fabric API: events, networking, rendering and registry hooks used by the mod (not embedded in lewandivka.jar).
GeckoLib: animated bosses, cats, NPCs and trams. 4.8.4 is the version the mod was compiled and tested against.
Lithium: game logic and AI optimisations (server and client).
FerriteCore: lower memory use.
Sodium: modern rendering engine, large FPS gain.
Indium: Fabric Rendering API support for Sodium (needed by Continuity).
Iris Shaders: optional shader support. The game never needs shaders.
More Culling: skips rendering of hidden blocks and entities.
ImmediatelyFast: faster immediate-mode rendering (HUD, text, entities).
Continuity: connected textures for glass and similar blocks.
LambDynamicLights: held lamps and glowing items light the area (CINEMATIC preset).
Visuality: extra ambient particles (CINEMATIC preset).
Particle Rain: rain and ambient particles (optional).
Sound Physics Remastered: reverb and occlusion for the garages and the tower.
Presence Footsteps: richer footstep sounds.
Handcrafted: furniture (couches, tables, chairs, shelves, cupboards, beds ...) for the flats, houses and rooms of the district.
Trep's Cars: drivable cars (the cars of the streets, the car parks and the garages of the district are cars of this mod; the block-built ones stand in without it).
Alcohol Only: beer, vodka, wine and Jaegermeister bottles, an alcohol barrel and a molotov (items for the kiosks, the garages and the chests of the district).

More Food: baguettes, cupcakes, ice cream, tacos, bacon, sausages and more (food for the chests and the market of the district; the metadata of the project says server only, its jar has the models for the client).
Fumee de Bushy: tobacco and cigarettes (stands in for Ciggycraft, which exists only for NeoForge 1.21.1).
Mod Menu: opens the mod's settings screen (screen shake, flashes, hints...).
MakeUp - Ultra Fast: the light shader of the CINEMATIC preset. Never mandatory: every puzzle is readable without it.
